plan: A mage who reflects projectiles and finishes off marked enemies wherever they are.
aSurveiller: Her W (Rebuttal). Her barrier reflects every projectile: don't cast ranged spells while it's active.
contrer: Don't throw your projectiles during her W: they come back at you.
Don't take too many of her marks: her R strikes every marked target.
Engage her once her W is used: it takes a long time to come back.
forces: Her R strikes every marked enemy.

sorts.P: Her spells empower her attacks and mark enemies.
sorts.Q: Volley that explodes over an area.
sorts.E: Orb that roots in the centre.
